d.ko: A mini citybuilding roguelike. Place buildings, stack combos, and master deep strategy in short bursts to create a tiny thriving metropolis!
d.en: A mini citybuilding roguelike. Place buildings, stack combos, and master deep strategy in short bursts to create a tiny thriving metropolis!
d.zh: 类Rogue城市营造迷你游戏。修造建筑，叠出连锁组合，钻研深度的策略，在一局局短平快的经营之中钻，建设出欣欣向荣的小小城邦！

A를 배치하기 위해선 B가 필요하고 B 배치한다면 C도 나오면 좋은데 계속 AAAACCCC만 주구장창 나와서 빌드가 안되는 느낌. 게임 하는 내내 뭔가 원재료가 없는데 계속 원재료를 가공하는 도구나 시너지만 나오는 느낌임.

Fun little indie game that scratches the same itch Balatro does. It starts humble, but your combos can reach ludicrous amounts. Biggest critique is that the game is considerably too easy, even at highest difficulty. …
Almost bounced off with a refund with the first couple hours of the game being a bit frustrating/dull due to the pace of unlocks Really glad I didn't. …

It seems this game has its fans and Im glad for them. But for me personally it feels really deriviative of a growing trend I really dislike in rougelikes having their main enjoyment be from meta progression instead of a good core gameplay …
连续几天玩了十几个小时，基本把游戏的玩法摸清了~ 强烈推荐！ 游戏易上手，随着等级逐渐解锁的各种物品和新的建筑又让游戏难精通，后期玩法非常丰富！ 优秀的美术表现，轻松愉快，加分的动效特别爽！ …
玩法的基本单元是桌游式的：玩家在方格中放置地块，获取分数。简洁、明确，每局都是轻量内容，简单休闲。 在此之上，使用了许多电子式的流行设计，比如三选一或遗物。 …
